findings.disposition_reason: Required original-image visual review incomplete because vision provider returned HTTP 402 insufficient_balance_error. Board-only observations are provisional, not a rejection of the art.
reference_comparison: Pale banded stone, flat mesa, green vegetation and brass placements broadly match the promotional board.
Viewer shading is flatter; cliffs and plants read less detailed. Stone can read as plaster/limestone; vegetation is stylized.
visual_limitations: Only comparison board successfully inspected with vision; individual marketing reference and four original PNGs were not successfully inspected.
Board shows both desktop/mobile closed/open views but is insufficient to verify fine detail or original-resolution UI legibility.
Closed marketing reference does not establish intended interior or open-lid construction.
Still images cannot verify continuous motion, hidden attachments or collisions. An apparent hinge clearance is not proof of detachment.
Source README was read for stated limitations, not treated as independent verification of its technical claims.
